text: We depend on foundries to manufacture our semiconductor wafers using their fabrication equipment and techniques. We do not own or operate fabrication facilities, and we rely on Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited and Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. to produce our products. A significant disruption at these suppliers, including one caused by geopolitical tensions involving Taiwan, could materially and adversely affect our business.

The U.S. government has imposed export controls restricting the sale of certain of our data center GPUs to China and other countries. These restrictions have affected and may continue to affect our ability to sell our products, and competitors not subject to similar restrictions may gain market share.
